Problems and reporting

Demiurges is still in development. These are the things you are most likely to notice.

Known gaps

  • A few rare messages are still shown in English, mostly in the Duel editor and in error messages.
  • Computer opponents follow the original's approach but do not copy its decisions exactly. As in the original, they never answer alliance or trade offers.
  • The campaigns are tested screen by screen and system by system, not yet by playing every chapter from start to finish.
  • There is no network multiplayer. Local hot seat duels work.
  • Touch controls have only been tried in testing, not yet on many real phones. The interface keeps the original layout, so on a small phone text and buttons are small.
  • Intro and ending videos are not played in the browser yet.

If the game does not start

  • Check that you chose the folder that contains Resources and Campaigns, or the GOG offline installer. See Installing the game files.
  • In the browser, make sure the page has enough storage and memory; on a phone, try a data pack.
  • On Windows and macOS, allow the unsigned app as described in Installing the game files.

Reporting a problem

Report problems on the issues page. Say which game and which system you use, and what you did before the problem appeared.
